title: The Secret
desc: When powerful businessman Amer vanishes, Detective Jad is drawn into a dangerous mystery. Amer's forced marriage to Taleen reveals a web of secrets, forbidden love, and betrayal.

title: Astitva
desc: Dr Simran, a renowned gynaecologist, marries Abhi, who is 10 years younger than her. However, her family disapproves of the match.

title: Agar Tum Saath Ho
desc: Neema, the daughter of a rich family, marries Ravi, a middle-class boy, against her father's wish.

title: Justujoo
desc: Lalit has an affair with his career-oriented sister-in-law, Neerja, as he is tired of his uneducated wife, Leela. He has a child with Neerja who is raised by Leela after Neerja dies during childbirth.
